commands.activity: List files created/modified/deleted and URLs fetched in this session
commands.add-dir: Add an external directory to workspace scope for this session
commands.agents: List all available subagents and their capabilities
commands.clean: Manually clean expired logs and temporary files (Housekeeping)
commands.clear: Clear conversation history while keeping attachments
commands.codesearch: Search code snippets and inject into conversation context
commands.compact: Summarize and compact conversation history to free context space
commands.config: View or edit global configuration (/config set <key> <value>)
commands.goal: Set a long-term goal for the Agent to pursue persistently
commands.image: Generate an image (uses pending attachments as reference)
commands.learn: Extract reusable skills from recent conversation
commands.mcp: List MCP tools (/mcp sqlite <path> switches SQLite database)
commands.model: Switch provider and model for this session
commands.new: Start a fresh conversation (auto-saves current session)
commands.prune: Clean expired or excess session history (/prune [<days> | --keep <n>])
commands.reasoning: Adjust reasoning effort (auto / high / medium / low / none)
commands.rm-dir: Remove an external directory from workspace scope for this session
commands.rm-file: Remove a file from pending attachments
commands.skills: List all available global and workspace skills
commands.subagent: Delegate a task to a specific subagent
commands.undo: Time machine: restore the last file modified by AI
commands.update: Check and apply the latest release update (auto-saves and restarts)
commands.usage: Show cumulative token usage for current session
